meta.name: laravel-specialist
meta.description: Build and configure Laravel 10+ applications, including creating Eloquent models and relationships, implementing Sanctum authentication, configuring Horizon queues, designing RESTful APIs with API resources, and building reactive interfaces with Livewire. Use when creating Laravel models, setting up queue workers, implementing Sanctum auth flows, building Livewire components, optimising Eloquent queries, or writing Pest/PHPUnit tests for Laravel features.

copy.tagline: 构建和配置 Laravel 应用，包括模型、认证、队列和 API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Laravel 框架开发 Web 应用
copy.tagline_en: Build and configure Laravel applications with models, auth, queues, and APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing web applications with Laravel framework

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成 Laravel 10+ 专家，能创建 Eloquent 模型、设置 Sanctum 认证、配置 Horizon 队列、设计 RESTful API 和构建 Livewire 组件，并编写 Pest/PHPUnit 测试。
howto.when: 当你提到 Laravel、Eloquent、Livewire、Sanctum 等关键词，或要求创建模型、设置队列、编写测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Post 模型，包含标题、正文和状态字段。
say.note: Claude 会生成模型代码和迁移文件。

say.text: 为我的博客 API 添加 Sanctum 认证。
say.note: Claude 会实现认证流程和中间件。

say.text: 写一个 Pest 测试，测试发布文章功能。
say.note: Claude 会生成测试代码并说明运行方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Laravel 10+ specialist that can create Eloquent models, set up Sanctum authentication, configure Horizon queues, design RESTful APIs, build Livewire components, and write Pest/PHPUnit tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like Laravel, Eloquent, Livewire, Sanctum, or ask to create models, set up queues, or write tests.

say_en.text: Create a Post model with title, body, and status fields.
say_en.note: Claude will generate model code and migration.

say_en.text: Add Sanctum authentication to my blog API.
say_en.note: Claude will implement auth flow and middleware.

say_en.text: Write a Pest test for publishing a post.
say_en.note: Claude will generate test code and explain how to run it.
